scope: Complete 41/55-instruction first/reference-and-second attachment descriptor callers; actual accepted clone, reference-intern, pool, selector and mutation implementations.

validation.scope: Unowned/owned first and second attachment, low-bit inputs, packed count and existing ring paths; selected integer, FP/cache/host state and ordinary RAM.
